text: In Mexico, Alejandra is a mother of two trapped in a joyless marriage to Ángel, who mocks gay men in public while secretly sleeping with her brother Fabián. Veronica, a young woman Fabián treats for a strange bite, has spent years visiting [a tentacled creature from a crashed meteor|origin|strangers who arrive] that an elderly couple keep in a barn. It gives her [a pleasure no man can match|wants|lust and indulgence], and when she leads Alejandra to it, [desire and violence become hard to tell apart|rules|how it hunts].
